name: sh-services-tax
description: Saint Helena island Services Tax for tax year 2026. Saint Helena has no VAT in the tax lists of the Income Tax Office. Services Tax is 10% on insurance and telecommunications services, charged by the provider, paid with a monthly return by the 15th. Covers exclusions, invoicing, refunds for unpaid accounts, records and offences. Use for VAT, GST, sales tax or service tax questions on St Helena. Does not apply to Ascension or Tristan da Cunha.
